title: Kelvin–Helmholtz billows
alt: A pale band of dye between two shear layers whose edges roll up into rows of spirals, outlined by a thin yellow-green line.
caption: Passive dye between two shear layers rolling up, Re = 400, t = 2 to 9.95. 384 × 192 Fourier modes, RK443, dt = 0.0025, CPU.
loop: run frames, then a 0.5 s cross-fade from the last frame to the first
shows: Dye concentration between two shear layers rolling up into billows.
legend: Colour: dye concentration, from 0 (dark) to 1 (light); the outline is concentration 1/2. Periodic box 4 × 2; the two shear layers are 1 apart, with half-thickness δ = 0.08 and velocity jump 2U with U = 1; time in these units.
span: The film shows t = 2 to 9.95 (simulation time) in 7.17 s of playback.

title: Rayleigh–Taylor instability
alt: Dark heavy fluid falls into pale light fluid in mushroom-shaped fingers that roll up and mix, while pale plumes rise.
caption: Heavy fluid falling into light fluid, Ra 1e7, computed with Conatus.
loop: fade from black over the first 7 frames and to black over the last 7 (the mixed end state is not the start state)
shows: Temperature as heavy fluid falls into light fluid.
legend: Colour: temperature, from −1/2 (dark, heavy fluid) to +1/2 (light fluid). Box 2 × 1 between rigid walls; time in thermal diffusion times of the depth.
details: Boussinesq, Pr = 1, from a rippled interface; 5.9 free-fall times. 512 × 256 Fourier × Chebyshev, RK443, dt = 7.5e-07, CPU.
span: The film shows t = 0.00015 to 0.00203 (simulation time) in 7.5 s of playback.
